_published_faq.name: How do I add Honeycomb to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Honeycomb to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.honeycomb.io/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: Is Honeycomb MCP ready for ChatGPT and Claude?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 14, 2026, Honeycomb scores 0/100 on Manufact's MCP publishing checklist. The scan does not yet meet ChatGPT publishing checks and does not yet meet Claude publishing checks. Passing these checks does not guarantee marketplace approval.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Honeycomb MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Honeycomb lists 13 MCP tools, including feedback, get_dataset, get_dataset_columns, get_environment, get_query_history, get_slos, get_team_info, get_trace, get_triggers, list_datasets, list_environments, and run_unsaved_query.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Honeycomb?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Honeycomb in developer-tools on the Manufact MCP catalog include Held at the Gate, Speko, turva.dev, AgentMail, and Celesto Cloud Computers.
Honeycomb requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.

_published_faq.name: Why is Honeycomb failing MCP readiness checks?

acceptedAnswer.text: Honeycomb scored 0/100 on the latest Manufact MCP publishing checklist, below the 70-point checklist threshold. The top failing check is Authenticated MCP access is available. Reconnect the server account or provide a valid refreshable OAuth session, then rerun the audit. Paste the MCP URL into the Manufact MCP catalog to rerun the scan.
Honeycomb is developed by honeycomb.io. It is listed as partner on the Claude connector directory.
